text:
amal: FYI seeing sustained inference p95 spike in ap-sg1-rack7 — jumped from ~120ms -> ~900ms at ~06:02 UTC. Alert shows GPU throttling + repeated Xid 13 entries. Investigating now.

kai: ok can you paste dmesg / nv-smi snapshot? also any recent infra changes in that rack?

amal: quick dump: 
```
$ dmesg | tail -n 20
[06:01:58] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13
[06:02:01] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00: Timeout during kernel execution
[06:02:04] kernel: nvidia: GPU 3 thermal trip
```
```
$ nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,FAN,POWER,PERF
GPU 0:
  Fan Speed                        : 0 %
  Temperature                      : 94 C
  Power Readings
    Power Draw                     : 122.50 W
    Power Limit                    : 150.00 W
  Clocks Throttle Reasons          : 0x80 (Thermal)
```

Also saw fan tach dropouts to 0 RPM intermittently.

elaine: rack7 had PSU firmware pushed yesterday at 02:00 UTC (rollout batch 12). Noted a warning in the rollout notes about transient PMIC OCPs on some boards. Could be related.

infra-oncall: starting triage runbook: mark affected hosts unschedulable and drain. Which hosts in rack7 are hot?

amal: hosts ap-sg1-rack7-host23/24/25 show the errors. Host24 has 3 cards with repeat Xid 13 and fan=0 on card1. Host23 has intermittent temp spikes.

ops-lucas: grabbing spare GPUs/boards from cage now, ETA ~45m. If it's PMIC/PSU we might need a board swap not just fans.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2357: ap-sg1 rack7 GPU thermal/power anomalies. Ops channel: #inc-2026-2357.

kai: routing note: I pushed a quick route to shift 20% inference traffic off ap-sg1 to eu-south1 and increased batching on the route to reduce QPS while we drain. Should ease tail latency.

elaine: can infra team check BMC logs and ipmi sensor for power rails? If PSU hit OCP it can flip power caps which explains power draw oscillation. BMC log excerpt showed: 
```
[06:03:12] PMIC: OCP EVENT on GPU_B0
[06:03:13] FRU: Resetting power rail on slot B
```

amal: plan proposed: drain host24 first, hot-swap problematic card + swap PSU if board PMIC shows faults. We'll keep 24 offline until Lucas confirms replacement.

infra-oncall: running: kubectl drain ap-sg1-rack7-host24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -w. Pods evicting now (06:20 UTC). Will reboot host after drain to exercise fans.

amal: after drain & routing change p95 dropped to ~130ms within 5m. Good signal. Keeping monitoring and will escalate to SEV if Xid 13 continues after hardware swap.

ops-lucas: confirmed spare board + blower fans staged. Proceeding with hot-swap once host24 power cycled and BMC shows clear.

kai: nice. keep traffic steering in place for 30m and revert if stable. :thumbsup:

elaine: I'll file a postmortem link in the incident once we have hardware root cause (fw vs PMIC vs fan controller). For now treat as hardware replacement + follow-up on PSU FW rollout.

infra-oncall: update 06:42 UTC: host24 rebooted, fans now show > 3000 RPM on boot, but Xid 13 persisted for one card after reboot — pulled it from the host (offline). Host24 will stay in maintenance.

amal: closing loop: traffic stable, p95 back to normal. Keeping host24 out of rotation pending Lucas swap and full burn test. Thanks all.
